suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific complication outcome risk. Require documented atherosclerotic lower-extremity peripheral artery disease, particularly advanced disease/critical limb-threatening ischemia where applicable, and separately documented major lower-extremity amputation occurring in the PAD clinical course. PMID 31606132 supports major amputation as a complication/outcome of atherosclerotic PAD; it does not independently verify non-amputation functional "loss of use." Do not generalize this evidence to venous disease, nonspecific vascular diagnoses, or assume that PAD establishes the cause of every individual amputation without appropriate clinical attribution. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
